Find Us with What 3 Words
A division of the Muskegon Counties Department of Public Works, Muskegon County GIS manages the County enterprise Geographic Information System (GIS). We provide spatial technologies, applications, and services in support of the business needs of the customers, departments, clients and public within Muskegon County. Within this new website and associated applications, we hope to engage, share, and highlight data and applications that will assist in your spatial information needs and that assist with departmental and municipal business needs. Make sure to check out the menu items at the top of the pages for various sections of the site and to access the applications, get more information and even browse our open data.
Featured Applications
The Following are a few featured public applications that are featured for a period of time. All of the GIS applications can be found on the Public Applications page and/or the Story Maps page.
August 4, 2026 Primary Election Results Viewer
This interactive application provides election results for the August 4, 2026 Primary Election in Muskegon County, Michigan.
Users can explore election results geographically and review vote totals for candidates and ballot proposals by precinct. The application is intended to provide the public with an accessible way to view and explore election results as they are reported.
Important: Results displayed in this application are unofficial election results and may be updated as additional results are received, reviewed, and processed. Results are not considered final until certified by the appropriate election authorities.
Property Information Viewer

Muskegon County GIS Project Team
Thomas Van Bruggen, GISP, MCAO
GIS Administrator, Muskegon County DPW / GIS
Thomas Van Bruggen started with Muskegon County in July of 1998 as the Geographic Information Technician in the Equalization Department. Thomas became the Property Information Analyst in 2008. In October of 2012, Thomas and the primary GIS functions were moved into the Information Technology Department and Thomas became the GIS Administrator to better serve all departments with the GIS technology available. In January of 2024, the centralized GIS operations were moved into the Muskegon County Department of Public Works as part of a restructuring of the Muskegon County IT operations. The Muskegon County GIS program has been developed and overseen since inception by Mr. Van Bruggen's guidance.
Thomas is a 1997 graduate of Central Michigan University with a Bachelors of Science in Cartography, Remote Sensing and Geographic Information Systems and is a certified GIS Professional (GISP) and Michigan Certified Assessing Officer (MCAO). Thomas serves on the Board of Directors of IMAGIN , a professional GIS organization serving Michigan and is the immediate past president. Thomas also serves on the State of Michigan GIS Advisory Group.
